feeds.title: Miss Northerner Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Kristen! I'm a photographer, travel writer, and entrepreneur currently living in Wisconsin with my husband and our cat Luna. I created Miss Northerner in 2017 and since then, it's become one of the largest personal travel & lifestyle blogs dedicated to the Midwest. I love showcasing the beauty of this part of the US and all it has to offer. From beautiful outdoor landscapes to unique stays, my goal is to share my personal travel experiences to help inspire others.

feeds.title: Blogging Mom of 4
feeds.description: Social Media Mom Juggling kids, home, brand, homeschooling, frugal living, and life's adventures.

feeds.title: Jasmine Maria
feeds.description: Jasmine Maria is a beauty + lifestyle blog with a focus on beauty, life, blogging and so much more. Jasmine's hope is that everybody will come to her blog to learn how to love the skin you're in. She posts occasional beauty tutorials, tips, guides, reviews, fashion, and of course lifestyle posts.

feeds.title: Wisconsin Mommy
feeds.description: Maureen Fitzgerald is a Milwaukee, Wisconsin influencer, brand enthusiast, and strategist. Wisconsin Mommy is a friendly lifestyle blog in the Milwaukee area that shares parenting tips, reviews, travel, recipes as well as local events for Wisconsin parents.

feeds.title: Small Town In Stilettos
feeds.description: I'm Megan, a former corporate retail merchandiser turned blogger. I created this site to help empower and inspire the everyday woman to always look and feel her absolute best.

feeds.title: What Riva Wore
feeds.description: My name is Riva Treasure. I've created this blog to share my personal style and my daily outfits. I love styling and mixing unexpected pieces. I'm a Milwaukee-based fashion and lifestyle blogger on good hair days, on bad hair days I believe in the restorative magic of wine and dry shampoo.

feeds.title: Kelsie Kristine
feeds.description: My name is Kelsie. I'm a dog mom & wife, married to a handsome handyman! My goal is to inspire women daily with affordable beauty, fashion, & home decor and to be the best girlfriend you never knew you needed!

feeds.title: Lifestyled by Leena
feeds.description: Lifestyled by Leena is a Fashion + Lifestyle Blog by Leena Asuma in Milwaukee, WI. Follow along for blogs about fashion, travel, and more.

feeds.title: Style 608
feeds.description: Style 608 is a fashion and lifestyle blog with deep roots in Wisconsin. Ashley works full time during the day in the creative design field and blog during the evenings.

feeds.title: Our Madison Life
feeds.description: Wisconsin Photographers who travel the world on a budget sharing their favorite things.

feeds.title: Heartland Lady Blog
feeds.description: Heartland Lady is a Wisconsin based lifestyle blog, featuring posts about wellness, style, home + garden, food, and arts. The aim of this blog is to inspire others to cook or garden or do any of these things which bring a sense of rootedness.
